LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.DockModeDesc:
Switch between loading and unloading.

Loading: capsules sent here go straight into the parked vehicle's cargo, as long as it has the weight to spare.

Unloading: the parked vehicle's cargo is sent, a capsule at a time, to the receiver this dock is pointed at. Needs empty capsule shells on the pad.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.DockSetDestinationDesc: Choose the tube receiver that unloaded cargo is sent to.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.DockFilterDesc: Choose which cargo this dock takes off vehicles. Anything not allowed stays aboard.
LanguageData.FactoryLogistics.DockFilterHint: Cargo allowed here is unloaded; everything else stays in the vehicle. Passengers are never unloaded.
